name: ember-nyc
description: EMBER — Emergency Management Body of Evidence & Resources (NYC)

scripts.test:regional: npm run build-config && node --test tests/map-overlay-selection.test.js tests/map-layer-evidence.test.js tests/esri-layers.test.js tests/map-builder-filters.test.js tests/regional-normalization.test.js tests/regional-geography.test.js tests/regional-observations.test.js tests/phase4-sources.test.js tests/report-window.test.js tests/map-interaction.test.js tests/weather-context.test.js && python3 -m unittest tests/test_config_loader.py tests/test_copilot_prompt.py tests/test_map_builder_filters.py tests/test_regional_normalization.py tests/test_regional_geography.py tests/test_regional_observations.py tests/test_phase4_sources.py tests/test_map_interaction.py
scripts.test:streamlit: python3 -m unittest tests/test_map_overlay_selection.py tests/test_arcgis_map_layers.py tests/test_arcgis_map_widgets.py tests/test_map_layer_evidence.py tests/test_chat_state.py tests/test_config_loader.py tests/test_copilot_prompt.py tests/test_esri_presentation.py tests/test_map_builder_filters.py tests/test_map_builder_presets.py tests/test_map_builder_state.py tests/test_regional_normalization.py tests/test_regional_geography.py tests/test_regional_observations.py tests/test_phase4_sources.py tests/test_map_interaction.py
scripts.phase3:gate: npm run validate-config && npm run test:regional && npm run test:streamlit && npm run build && node scripts/validate-phase-3.js && PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/private/tmp/openember-phase3-pycache python3 -m py_compile streamlit/config_loader.py streamlit/copilot_prompt.py streamlit/map_interaction.py streamlit/regional_normalization.py streamlit/regional_geography.py streamlit/regional_observations.py streamlit/tidal_gauges.py streamlit/app.py && git diff --check
scripts.phase4:gate: npm run phase3:gate && node scripts/validate-phase-4.js && PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/private/tmp/openember-phase4-pycache python3 -m py_compile streamlit/arcgis_map_layers.py streamlit/map_layer_evidence.py streamlit/phase4_sources.py streamlit/map_builder_filters.py streamlit/map_builder_state.py && npm run test:cloud-uploads && npm run test:request-scope && npm run test:grounding && npm run test:evidence && npm run test:corrective && npm run test:location-evidence && git diff --check
scripts.test:corrective: node --test tests/corrective.test.js tests/focused-correction.test.js tests/kfrg.test.js tests/emergency-context.test.js tests/selected-location.test.js tests/jurisdiction-lookup.test.js && python3 -m unittest tests/test_corrective.py tests/test_focused_correction.py tests/test_kfrg.py tests/test_emergency_context.py tests/test_selected_location.py tests/test_jurisdiction_lookup.py
